items.source: Create a new SingleColumnRowMapper for bean-style configuration.
items.translation: 为基于 Bean 的配置方式创建一个新的SingleColumnRowMapper。

items.source: Create a new SingleColumnRowMapper.
items.translation: 创建一个新的SingleColumnRowMapper。

items.source: Static factory method to create a new SingleColumnRowMapper (with the required type specified only once).
items.translation: 静态工厂方法用于创建新的SingleColumnRowMapper（只需指定一次所需的类型）。

items.source: Retrieve a CQL object value for the specified column.
items.translation: 检索指定列的 CQL 对象值。

items.source: Extract a value for the single column in the current row.
items.translation: 提取当前行单列的值。

items.source: Set the type that each result object is expected to match.
items.translation: 设置每个结果对象预期匹配的类型。

items.source: row - is the Row holding the data, must not be null.
items.translation: row - 是包含数据的 Row，不能为 null。

items.source: requiredType - the type that each result object is expected to match
items.translation: requiredType - 每个结果对象预期匹配的类型

items.source: index - is the column index
items.translation: index - 表示列索引

items.source: the Object value.
items.translation: 对象值。

items.source: The default implementation calls RowUtils.getRowValue(Row, int, Class). If no required type has been specified, this method delegates to getColumnValue(rs, index), which basically calls GettableByIndex.getObject(int) but applies some additional default conversion to appropriate value types.
items.translation: 默认实现会调用RowUtils.getRowValue(Row, int, Class)。如果未指定所需的类型，此方法将委托给getColumnValue(rs, index)，该方法基本调用GettableByIndex.getObject(int)，但会应用一些额外的默认转换以适配适当的值类型。

items.source: The default implementation delegates to RowUtils.getRowValue(Row, int, Class), which uses the GettableByIndex.getObject(int) method.
items.translation: 默认实现会委托给 RowUtils.getRowValue(Row, int, Class)，该方法使用GettableByIndex.getObject(int)。

items.source: Consider using the newInstance(Class) factory method instead, which allows for specifying the required type once only.
items.translation: 请改用newInstance(Class)工厂方法，该方法只需指定一次所需的类型。

items.source: Validates that there is only one column selected, then delegates to getColumnValue() and also convertValueToRequiredType, if necessary.
items.translation: 验证仅有一列被选中，然后委托给 getColumnValue() 以及（如有必要）convertValueToRequiredType。

items.source: The type of the result value for each row can be specified. The value for the single column will be extracted from a Row and converted into the specified target type.
items.translation: 每行结果值的类型可以指定。单列的值将从 Row 中提取并转换为指定的目标类型。

items.source: If not specified, the column value will be exposed as returned by the Row.
items.translation: 如果未指定，列值将按 `<code>Row` 返回的方式暴露。

items.source: If the required type is String, the value will simply get stringified via toString(). In case of a Number, the value will be converted into a Number, either through number conversion or through String parsing (depending on the value type).
items.translation: 如果所需类型为 String，值将通过 `toString()` 直接转换为字符串。如果是 Number 类型，则会根据值的类型，通过数值转换或字符串解析将其转换为 Number。

items.source: Convert the given column value to the specified required type.
items.translation: 将给定的列值转换为指定的所需类型。

items.source: Retrieve a object value for the specified column, using the most appropriate value type.
items.translation: 使用最合适的值类型检索指定列的对象值。

items.source: mapRow in interface RowMapper<T extends @Nullable Object>
items.translation: mapRow 接口 RowMapper<T extends @Nullable Object> 中的方法

items.source: com.datastax.oss.driver.api.core.DriverException - if a DriverException is encountered getting column values (that is, there's no need to catch DriverException)
items.translation: com.datastax.oss.driver.api.core.DriverException - 如果在获取列值时遇到 DriverException（即无需捕获 DriverException）

items.source: row - the Row to map, must not be null.
items.translation: row - 要映射的 Row，不能为 null。

items.source: value - the column value as extracted from getColumnValue() (never null)
items.translation: value - 从 getColumnValue() 提取的列值（永远不会为 null）

items.source: rowNum - the number of the current row.
items.translation: rowNum - 当前行的行号。

items.source: requiredType - the type that each result object is expected to match (or null if none specified).
items.translation: requiredType - 每个结果对象预期匹配的类型（如果未指定则为 null）。

items.source: com.datastax.oss.driver.api.core.DriverException - in case of extraction failure
items.translation: com.datastax.oss.driver.api.core.DriverException - 在提取失败的情况下

items.translation: com.datastax.oss.driver.api.core.DriverException - 在提取失败的情况下。

items.source: requiredType - the type that each result object is expected to match (never null)
items.translation: requiredType - 每个结果对象预期匹配的类型（绝不能为 null）

items.translation: 马克·帕卢赫

items.translation: 当前行的结果对象。

items.source: the converted value
items.translation: 转换后的值

items.source: RowMapper implementation that converts a single column into a single result value per row. Expects to operate on a Row that just contains a single column.
items.translation: RowMapper 实现，用于将单列转换为每行对应的单个结果值。预期操作的对象是仅包含一列的 Row。

items.source:
Retrieve a object value for the specified column, using the most appropriate value type. Called if no required type
has been specified.
items.translation: 使用最合适的值类型检索指定列的对象值。如果未指定必需的类型，则调用此方法。

items.source:
Convert the given column value to the specified required type. Only called if the extracted column value does not
match already.
items.translation: 将给定的列值转换为指定的所需类型。仅当提取的列值不匹配时调用。
